name: FluffCoin
description: FluffCoin was born in a cloud of cotton candy during a Minecraft thunderstorm. It powers bunny economies and grows in value every time someone pets a virtual sheep.

name: ShroomBuck
description: ShroomBuck is the #1 currency used by underground mushroom farmers. It gains value when players crouch too much and loses it when cows moo too loudly.

name: DirtDoubloon
description: Mined exclusively from level 1 dirt blocks, DirtDoubloon is backed by the full faith of shovels everywhere. Traders believe it contains ancient worm magic.

name: Meowmium
description: A coin forged from pure cat energy. Every time a Minecraft cat purrs, Meowmium gains power. But beware—creepers secretly manipulate its market value at night.

name: Yeetium
description: Invented after a villager was yeeted into the void, Yeetium is unpredictable and wild. Investors usually scream 'YOLO' before buying in. Crashes? It calls them 'skydives.'

name: Woollar
description: The Woollar economy is controlled entirely by Minecraft sheep consortia. Prices spike during shearing season and drop when players forget to dye their wool.

name: SlimeNickel
description: SlimeNickel jiggles in price every 30 seconds. It’s mostly sticky, partially green, and universally regarded as 'squishy money.'

name: Brickz
description: Brickz are used by villagers to build economic empires, one pixel at a time. Rumor has it the Iron Golems secretly hold 50% of the supply.

name: MineBean
description: A volatile legume-based coin that sprouted in the jungles of Minecraft. Beans are power. Beans are chaos. Beans cannot be trusted.

name: Spookle
description: Created by ghost miners from the Nether, Spookle is highly unstable, glows faintly in the dark, and sometimes howls during price crashes.

name: CreeperCash
description: The most explosive investment you can make. Literally. Every time a creeper explodes, someone somewhere either gets rich—or rage quits.

name: Enderium
description: Forged in the eyes of Endermen, Enderium teleports value from your pockets to the void if you look at it wrong. Long-term holders stare at the ground.

name: PiggyPound
description: The official currency of Minecraft pigs. Oinks-per-second directly affect the market price. Especially volatile during apple harvests.

name: BoomerangCoin
description: It always comes back… unless it doesn’t. Tied to the mysterious laws of boomerang physics in Minecraft, its value yo-yos like no tomorrow.

name: ChonkDollar
description: The fatter the mob, the stronger the coin. ChonkDollar surges when cows, hoglins, or players in full netherite armor jump. It’s big. It's beefy. It’s chonk.

name: LavaToken
description: LavaToken burns bright and dies young. Used primarily in the Nether’s black-market cauldron casinos. Fire-resistant holders only.

name: SnaccCoin
description: SnaccCoin is earned by eating cake, cookies, or suspicious stew. Each bite makes it tastier. Side effects include hallucinating future profits.

name: Obsidollar
description: So dense, it barely moves. Backed by portals and pain, Obsidollar is mined slowly and hoarded by elitist builders with too much time.

name: ZomboBuck
description: Mined from rotten flesh and poor decisions, ZomboBuck moans as it grows. Spend it fast—its holders tend to wander off and groan a lot.

name: BedrockBar
description: Unmovable, indestructible, and completely fake—just like its value. Only obtainable through admin dreams and market delusion.

name: FishCoin
description: FishCoin flops onto the market every time someone fishes up a boot. Its value swims upstream and downstream with absolutely no warning or logic.

name: Redstonium
description: Born from overengineered contraptions and repeater rage, Redstonium powers the most complex scams in the memecoin world.

name: BorkToken
description: BorkToken is bark-backed, wolf-fueled currency with howls per second as its primary metric. Value spikes during full moons and squirrel sightings.

name: DustDollar
description: Swept from beneath Minecraft beds and old mob farms, DustDollar is what happens when a vacuum cleaner starts trading NFTs.

name: CobbleCred
description: Every miner’s first love. CobbleCred has no rarity, no logic, and no brakes. Used primarily to bribe villagers into mediocre trades.

name: MooNet
description: The only cow-powered cryptocurrency. MooNet pays dividends in raw beef and existential dread. Often goes 'udderly' parabolic.

name: BlazeBit
description: BlazeBit burns hotter than the Nether. Spawned in a blaze spawner accident, it attracts moths and financial masochists.

name: SnortBux
description: SnortBux was invented when a Minecraft pig accidentally typed a whitepaper. It's oink-stable and backed by pure truffle speculation.

name: GravelGroat
description: Falls apart under pressure and has a 90% chance to crush your dreams. GravelGroat is the scratch-off ticket of the crypto world.

name: PhantomToken
description: Only appears when you haven’t slept in 3 days. PhantomToken grows in value the more sleep-deprived the server is.

name: BonkByte
description: BonkByte is the official currency of accidental slap fights. Its value increases with each player-to-player bonk, especially with a stick.

name: Glowdust
description: Harvested from overly excited glow squids, Glowdust shines brightest right before a dump. It's the only coin that sparkles during a crash.

name: ToadCoin
description: ToadCoin bounces between lily pads of valuation. Only accepted by swamp dwellers and enchanted frogs with a flair for chaos.

name: Ghastash
description: Ghastash is powered by ghostly tears and mid-air regrets. It's emotionally unstable and tends to scream when sold.

name: Eggonomic
description: Eggonomic was hatched by mistake and immediately started breaking. It rewards those who believe in yolk-based wealth systems.

name: Boopium
description: Boopium gains 0.01% in value per nose-boop. Backed by pure vibes and fuzzy pixels, it collapses instantly when hugged too hard.

name: SpudToken
description: SpudToken is grown in coarse farmland and appreciated by baked goods everywhere. Investors describe it as 'comfortably starchy.'

name: PanicCoin
description: The only memecoin designed to induce and reflect panic in real-time. PanicCoin spikes when players scream IRL or fall into lava.

name: LoafCash
description: LoafCash is soft, squishy, and mysteriously warm. The more it's ignored, the more valuable it becomes. Just like forgotten bread.

name: PickleBit
description: PickleBit brines itself in unpredictable liquidity. Salty, sour, and slightly unhinged, it's accepted at only the dankest of economic establishments.

name: Planktonium
description: Harvested from microscopic sea mobs, Planktonium fuels tiny economies that only exist in puddles and dreams. Extremely small. Possibly imaginary.

name: CringeCoin
description: CringeCoin is mined whenever someone says 'let’s pump it' in chat. The more embarrassing the hype, the more it rises. Market cap is based on secondhand shame.

name: Toastium
description: Slightly burnt but still edible, Toastium appeals to breakfast maximalists. Its price fluctuates based on the golden-brownness of its crust.

name: VoidNickel
description: VoidNickel only exists when nobody is looking. If a coin falls into the void and no one is around to hear it... it probably still crashed.

name: BoingBuck
description: BoingBuck rebounds violently every 30 seconds. Designed by slime block engineers and trampoline anarchists. Can’t stop, won’t stop bouncing.

name: Meltium
description: Meltium drips in value during heat waves. Liquidity is literal. It once evaporated during a particularly intense PvP match.

name: SaplingCred
description: The greener your trades, the better. SaplingCred is photosynthesis-backed, leaf-indexed, and probably illegal in deserts.

name: EchoBit
description: EchoBit repeats every financial mistake twice. Known for echoing the last price movement forever, even when no one's trading it anymore.

name: LagCoin
description: LagCoin slows down every transaction it touches. Valued mostly by time travelers and players still stuck loading chunks from 2022.

name: Crumblo
description: Crumblo is made from fallen cookie pieces and crushed economic dreams. It’s flaky, sweet, and usually ends up under your inventory bar.

name: SlapCoin
description: Every time a player gets slapped off a cliff by a mob, SlapCoin gains a tiny amount of market respect. Used mostly in PvP arenas and regretful trades.

name: BubbleBuck
description: BubbleBuck floats gently above the economy, popping occasionally. Prized by underwater builders and those who speak in emotes only.

name: SizzleCent
description: SizzleCent was born in a frying pan and raised in a smelter. It sizzles louder the closer it gets to bankruptcy. Best stored in a blast furnace.

name: Moocha
description: Part cow, part espresso shot, Moocha is a jittery coin with too much energy and no chill. Frequently spikes during milking hours.

name: VoidPebble
description: Tiny, insignificant, and utterly unstoppable. VoidPebble travels faster than logic and is typically found after rage-quitting the server.

name: SnugBuck
description: SnugBuck is soft, warm, and 100% emotional value. It’s the only coin that gets sad when sold. Popular among llamas and lonely players.

name: ZingyToken
description: ZingyToken tastes like lemons and burns like nether wart. Completely unpredictable, but always has good vibes and questionable motives.

name: CrustCoin
description: CrustCoin forms naturally at the edge of forgotten bread. Market analysts are unsure if it’s a good investment or a biological hazard.

name: Booplet
description: Booplet is the tiniest form of digital affection. Each coin transaction must include a gentle boop. Violations result in cuteness fines.

name: WobbleBit
description: WobbleBit never quite stabilizes. It leans left, shakes right, and occasionally moonwalks in value. Trusted only by professional jesters.

name: HonkCred
description: HonkCred is based entirely on the economy of angry geese. The louder the honk, the higher the price. Goose interference is not only possible—it’s expected.

name: DoodleBuck
description: Invented during a server maintenance break, DoodleBuck has no real use, but it looks great on napkins. Drawn, not mined.

name: ZapCoin
description: ZapCoin is energized every time a lightning strike hits something it wasn’t supposed to. Shockingly unstable and best handled with rubber gloves.

name: SnoozeBit
description: SnoozeBit appreciates slowly and only when no one is awake. Value collapses instantly if more than two players log in at once.

name: PlopToken
description: PlopToken appears whenever something falls into water. Its economy is splash-based and heavily influenced by boat-related chaos.

name: FizzleCash
description: Once destined to be the next big thing, FizzleCash always fizzles out right before takeoff. It’s the thought that counts.

name: BarkBit
description: BarkBit howls during full moons and climbs in value when wolves form packs. Known for sudden spikes and tail wags.

name: WaffleCoin
description: WaffleCoin is syrup-backed and gridlocked. It’s sweet, sticky, and always gets stuck in economic crevices. Breakfast investors only.

name: Meepium
description: Nobody knows what Meepium does or where it came from. It just meeps quietly in your wallet and occasionally triples in price for no reason.

name: OopsieToken
description: Minted by accident during a failed database migration, OopsieToken is now a beloved disaster. It grows each time someone presses the wrong button.

name: SniffleCoin
description: SniffleCoin gains value whenever a Minecraft dog sneezes or a player says 'oops'. It's allergen-sensitive and partially backed by used tissues.

name: Derpium
description: Derpium is forged from typos, lag spikes, and facepalms. Highly reactive to dumb decisions. The dumber the trade, the better it performs.

name: NomNomBuck
description: Fueled by snack breaks and cookie crumbs, NomNomBuck is only usable while eating in real life. Best stored next to your lunch.

name: SplootCoin
description: SplootCoin is the preferred currency of lounging animals. Its price rises with every adorable stretch. Backed by pure comfort energy.

name: GlitchToken
description: GlitchToken multiplies when the game bugs out and disappears when patched. It's the ghost in the machine—and your wallet.

name: PebblePay
description: The smallest possible unit of imaginary value. PebblePay is used by ants and forgotten side quests. It’s mostly harmless.

name: NapCoin
description: NapCoin is earned by doing nothing. Just lay down and let your assets nap with you. Loses value if you’re too productive.

name: Hootium
description: Powered by owl wisdom and midnight trades, Hootium rewards late-night activity. Screeches occasionally for no clear reason.

name: FartBuck
description: Juvenile, unstable, and loud—FartBuck inflates fast and crashes even faster. Traders say it 'rips' through resistance levels.

name: SplatCred
description: Created in a failed potion experiment, SplatCred appears with each messy landing. Messier trades = higher returns (or worse bruises).

name: GloopCoin
description: GloopCoin is sticky, slow-moving, and impossible to clean up. It increases in value every time someone walks into a slime chunk by accident.

name: BlorpBuck
description: Born from swamp bubbles and bad ideas, BlorpBuck sounds as weird as it behaves. Market movements go ‘blorp’ without explanation.

name: JellyCent
description: Soft, wobbly, and questionably edible, JellyCent is the dessert of digital currencies. Frequently melts when prices drop.

name: Crunkle
description: Crunkle was created when someone sat on a pile of enchanted books. Its financial model is entirely based on page crinkle density.

name: Pogonium
description: Pogonium gains value from gamer hype. The louder the 'Pog!' in chat, the stronger it becomes. Loses value to cringe.

name: YapToken
description: Used in doggo diplomacy and bark-backed loans. YapToken increases with barking velocity and tail-wag frequency.

name: BoingCred
description: A spring-loaded currency that jumps in random directions. Traders bounce between hope and chaos with every tick.

name: MuffinCoin
description: Soft and explosive, MuffinCoin bakes its way through the market. May contain blueberries and unpredictable spikes.

name: Oopsium
description: Oopsium was added to the blockchain by mistake and no one wants to remove it. Thrives on regret and happy accidents.

name: MlemBux
description: Every time a Minecraft wolf does a 'mlem' with its tongue, MlemBux gets stronger. Cutest coin in the market by far.

name: WibbleToken
description: WibbleToken is emotionally unstable and tends to spiral. Highly sensitive to the moon phase and player feelings.

name: DoofDime
description: DoofDime is for the fools, by the fools. Its market strategy is 'just wing it' and it’s surprisingly effective.

name: CrunchNickel
description: Sounds expensive, feels like gravel. CrunchNickel is traded almost exclusively by skeletons with bad knees.

name: ZzzzCoin
description: ZzzzCoin rewards AFK players with sweet dreams and small dividends. Moves slowly, yawns often.

name: DerpyBit
description: Every chart involving DerpyBit ends up upside-down. Gains value through confusion and forehead slaps.

name: TwinkleBuck
description: TwinkleBuck sparkles during clear nights and crashes during thunderstorms. Loved by star-gazers and moon-pricers.

name: Beepium
description: Beepium was discovered in a redstone repeater loop. Emits a pleasant beep every time it gains or loses value.

name: Snortium
description: Snortium is laugh-react-backed and gains 1% every time someone giggles at the chart. It’s literally nose-powered.

name: ThunkCoin
description: ThunkCoin is dropped by accident, picked up by chance, and hoarded for no reason. It goes 'thunk' when invested badly.

name: SpookBuck
description: SpookBuck appears behind you when you’re not looking. Haunted. Terrifying. Weirdly profitable near Halloween.
